hooks.text: 亲手把网线插进交换机路由与竖井
hooks.excerpt: Physically connect your clients to your networks by patching cables into switches, routers and data risers.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 预算超支被开除客户投诉即结束
hooks.excerpt: Your board of directors have a strict policy where you must never go over-budget or face termination from your role . Additionally, some of your clients have service level agreements (SLA) and you must ensure their internet connection (and the services they need) stays up. If any of them files a complaint, then its game-over! .
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 用命令行追踪设备安装服务排查故障
hooks.excerpt: Trace connectivity between equipment, scan for devices, install server applications and troubleshoot your network issues all using the good-ole terminal console.
